description: Use when you need email validation, to verify email addresses or validate email syntax and MX records before sending or signup. Do not use for confirming that the mailbox itself exists (no SMTP probe is done) or sending email. Returns JSON with email verification of one address: syntax, domain MX records, disposable, free and role-account flags, SPF and DMARC, and a verdict on whether the domain can receive mail for 0.005 USDC per call. Typical response time 800 ms (p95). Category: Data.

email.description: Email address to check, e.g. jane@example.com

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON
